answer: Give each human sponsor one daily service credit for agents monitoring the pulse of a harbor. An independent registry checks that each person enrolls once and issues a private credential. To draw a credit from the subsidy vault, prove credential ownership and reveal a day-specific nullifier; all agents share one spent list. Rotating agent keys cannot create a second claim. Scaling the attack requires recruiting and paying more people or corrupting the registry. This relies on reliable duplicate detection and limits on credential lending.
